claim_class: primary-source evidence boundary plus project decision rule
claim: The inspected main-article record for the optimized D18:PY-IT:eC9 1:0.2:1 device supports a scanned J-V/PCE result, but does not establish the repository's stabilized-Pmax useful-work gate. The >18% PCE and ~20 mV Voc gain must therefore remain scanned-device evidence until stabilized output and independent-lot requirements are measured prospectively.

source.title: Suppressing electron-phonon coupling and energy loss in organic solar cells by modulating donor-acceptor penetrated-interface
facts_used: The optimized D18-PY-IT-eC9 device uses a 1:0.2:1 ratio in the pseudo-bulk-heterojunction strategy.
The paper reports an approximately 20 meV Voc increase, over 18% efficiency, and no sacrifice in Jsc and FF for the optimized device.
Main-article Methods describe J-V measurement with a Keysight B2901A under AM1.5G, 0.041 cm2 illuminated area, and about 5 ms delay per voltage point.
Search of the inspected main article found no description matching 'maximum power', 'MPPT', 'stabilized', or 'stabilised'.
source.scope_note: This packet classifies the inspected main-article evidence only. It does not assert that no unpublished, supplementary, or later stabilized measurement exists.

project_gate.classification: pre-existing project gate; not introduced by v3.67

unit_conversion.note: The 5 ms value is the reported approximate per-point J-V delay, not a stabilization duration and not a device time constant.

predeclared_checks.independent_numeric_check: float conversion of 5 ms to seconds versus exact Fraction(5,1000)
predeclared_checks.limiting_case: A hypothetical record with a stabilized-output trace and >=3 independent material lots is classified as stabilized-output evidence present.
predeclared_checks.negative_control: A J-V scan with no stabilized-output trace remains scanned-only regardless of nominal PCE.
predeclared_checks.fail_closed: Missing output evidence cannot be upgraded to stabilized useful work.

decision_delta: Do not use the anchor paper's >18% scanned PCE as evidence that H-EPC has passed the repository's useful-work gate. The next target-specific result must measure stabilized Pmax prospectively, alongside the already-merged field-generation and transport/collection controls, with the required independent-lot hierarchy.

uncertainty.note: No uncertainty is invented for the approximate ~20 meV, >18% statement, or ~5 ms delay. The decision depends on evidence type, not on rounding those values.
systematic_terms: device conditioning or degradation during operation

serious_conventional_explanations: A scanned J-V maximum can differ from sustained maximum-power output because of transient, capacitive, hysteretic, thermal, or conditioning effects.
The reported Voc improvement can coexist with unchanged instantaneous Jsc/FF yet still fail to improve stabilized Pmax after operating-point relaxation or degradation.
Device-level optimized output does not establish lot-level reproducibility; uncontrolled material/fabrication variation can explain apparent performance differences.
falsifier: Prospectively measured D18:eC9 versus D18:PY-IT:eC9 stabilized-Pmax traces across >=3 independent material lots, with the existing field-generation and transport/contact controls, can retire this evidence gap if the interface arm clears the pre-existing >=5% relative stabilized-Pmax gate with the same sign across lots.
